project: PrimeKG Graph Composition + R-GCN for DDI Prediction
interpretation: The implemented research prototype passed data, graph, ranking, checkpoint, mapping, reproducibility, and end-to-end inference checks. This verifies technical operation of the experimental system, not clinical validity.

checks.what_was_checked: All G0-G3 message-passing graphs contain only training drug_drug target edges; validation and test DDIs are absent.
checks.key_result: Validation leakage = 0; Test leakage = 0; 1,069,080 identical undirected training DDI pairs in every graph.

checks.what_was_checked: 1,000 held-out test DDI pairs were evaluated in both directions against all 4,278 candidate drugs.
checks.key_result: 2,000 ranking queries; MRR = 0.502226; Hits@1 = 0.4525; Hits@5 = 0.5465; Hits@10 = 0.5870; median rank = 2.

checks.what_was_checked: 5,000 held-out positive DDIs were compared with 5,000 sampled drug pairs absent from the known positive DDI set.
checks.key_result: ROC-AUC = 0.9737; positive pairwise win rate = 97.54%; positive median score = 6.497307; unobserved median score = -1.558111.

checks.what_was_checked: R-GCN node IDs were mapped back to verified PrimeKG entity names and DrugBank identifiers, then real held-out predictions were inspected.
checks.key_result: 13,094/13,094 graph nodes resolved; 4,278/4,278 candidate drugs resolved; 5/5 inspected held-out targets appeared at their expected Top-10 filtered ranks.

checks.what_was_checked: A fresh model object loaded G3 Seed 44 from disk and reran full filtered ranking on the complete test set.
checks.key_result: 133,614 test pairs / 267,228 directional queries; MRR = 0.540359; Hits@1 = 0.490656; Hits@5 = 0.588273; Hits@10 = 0.626229; all reproduced within 1e-6.

checks.what_was_checked: Relation IDs, relation semantics, active relation sets, and edge counts were independently verified for G0-G3.
checks.key_result: G0 = 2,138,160 edges; G1 = 2,189,466; G2 = 2,223,422; G3 = 2,274,728; all compositions exactly match the locked design.

checks.what_was_checked: A completely separate Python process loaded saved graph, checkpoint, drug metadata, and known-positive mask and performed real-name inference.
checks.key_result: Standalone exit code = 0; Colchicine correctly resolved to DB01394 / node 3121; known positives and self were filtered; Top-10 unobserved candidate links returned successfully.
